Content collections

Content collections group related Markdown files under src/content so every entry is validated before the site builds.

Defining a collection​

Create a collection with defineCollection() in src/content/config.ts and export it from the collections object.

export const collections = { docs: defineCollection({ type: "content" }) };

Collection schema options​

Pass a zod schema to validate each entry's frontmatter. Fields the schema marks optional may be omitted; unknown fields fail the build unless the schema is passthrough.

schema: z.object({ title: z.string(), draft: z.boolean().optional() })

Querying collections​

Call getCollection() to load every entry of a collection at build time, or getEntry() for one.
